# Delaware Elite Roofing
> Residential roofing contractor serving Delaware County, Ohio: roof replacement, roof repair, leak repair, storm (hail and wind) damage restoration with insurance documentation, emergency tarping, gutters and free roof inspections.

Phone: (740) 555-0177
Website: https://delawareeliteroofing.com
Email: info@delawareeliteroofing.com
Hours: Mon–Fri 7am–6pm, Sat 8am–2pm; storm calls 24/7

## Services
- [Roof Replacement](https://delawareeliteroofing.com/roof-replacement.html): Tear-off re-roofs for aging subdivision homes, permit included
- [Roof Repair](https://delawareeliteroofing.com/roof-repair.html): Shingle, flashing and pipe-boot repairs with honest advice
- [Roof Leak Repair](https://delawareeliteroofing.com/roof-leak-repair.html): Trace the real source of the drip and fix it for good
- [Storm Damage Roof Repair](https://delawareeliteroofing.com/storm-damage-roof-repair.html): Hail, wind and tornado damage documented for your insurer
- [Emergency Roof Tarping](https://delawareeliteroofing.com/emergency-roof-tarping.html): 24/7 storm tarping to stop water until repairs are made
- [HOA-Approved Roof Replacement](https://delawareeliteroofing.com/hoa-roof-replacement.html): Design-review packets and approved colors, handled for you
- [Metal Roofing](https://delawareeliteroofing.com/metal-roofing.html): Standing-seam homes, panel barns, built for open-field wind
- [Gutter Installation and Repair](https://delawareeliteroofing.com/gutters.html): Seamless gutters sized for big roofs and heavy runoff
- [Roof Inspection](https://delawareeliteroofing.com/roof-inspection.html): Free photo-documented inspections for storms, sales, aging roofs

## Service areas
- [Delaware County](https://delawareeliteroofing.com/delaware-county-oh-roofing.html): Roofing for every township, city and village in the county
- [Ashley](https://delawareeliteroofing.com/ashley-oh-roofing.html): Repair-first roofing for a village laid out in 1849
- [Berlin Township](https://delawareeliteroofing.com/berlin-township-oh-roofing.html): 2024 tornado path, newer HOA subdivisions
- [Concord Township](https://delawareeliteroofing.com/concord-township-oh-roofing.html): Scioto Reserve DRB approvals and 1997–98-era roofs
- [Delaware](https://delawareeliteroofing.com/delaware-oh-roofing.html): Historic homes, carriage houses and newer builds in the county seat
- [Galena](https://delawareeliteroofing.com/galena-oh-roofing.html): Older village homes and 2024 tornado inspections
- [Genoa Township](https://delawareeliteroofing.com/genoa-township-oh-roofing.html): Boom-era 1998–2003 roofs reaching replacement age
- [Lewis Center](https://delawareeliteroofing.com/lewis-center-oh-roofing.html): Orange Township subdivisions from the 2004 building peak
- [Liberty Township](https://delawareeliteroofing.com/liberty-township-oh-roofing.html): Olentangy Falls-era homes and one-acre lots
- [Ostrander](https://delawareeliteroofing.com/ostrander-oh-roofing.html): Fast-growing village with a two-layer permit process
- [Powell](https://delawareeliteroofing.com/powell-oh-roofing.html): Re-roof permits, photo submittals and Golf Village homes
- [Sunbury](https://delawareeliteroofing.com/sunbury-oh-roofing.html): Storm inspections near the 2024 tornado path and Northstar
